scope: 28-page smoke baseline + 3 targeted migration risk reproductions + 3 pure set parser assertions; this is not a full security audit or rerun of prior 69 cases.

findings.source: app.js:85 libraryPage raw p.sex + app.js:149 importLibraries row.sex
findings.detail: A benign imported sex value created an HTML img element and its error handler set an in-memory marker. Isolated synthetic browser data only; no network transmission or user storage modification.
findings.productionImpact: Stored XSS if this raw rendering/import pattern is carried into production.

findings.detail: Analyst referencing a missing role still obtained all 28 menu entries through fallback. This is a client-side Mock behavior, not a demonstrated server authorization bypass.
findings.productionImpact: Unknown/deleted roles must fail closed; server must enforce permissions independently.

findings.source: app.js:19 only JSON parse guard; app.js:29 db.users.find
findings.detail: Syntactically valid but structurally invalid local storage {} broke login with a page error. Persisted-state schema/version recovery is required.
findings.productionImpact: Unavailable UI after incompatible or corrupted persisted state; avoid sensitive production state in localStorage.
